overview_description.description: Founded in May of 2013 and based in San Francisco, California, Asseta is a marketplace for companies to quickly and safely buy semiconductor parts from suppliers around the world. Whether it's a used chamber assembly, a refurbished power supply, or a new o-ring in factory sealed packaging, Asseta helps you find the part you need, in the condition you need it, at 50-60% less than OEM pricing.
